reason.locked: in use by another program or access denied — close that program and try again
reason.unstable: changed while being copied — try again when the program writing it has finished
reason.mismatch: the bytes on the backup drive twice did not match the original — the drive may be faulty
reason.yanked: the drive was disconnected during the backup
reason.disk_full: the drive ran out of space
reason.too_big_for_fs: files of 4 GB or more do not fit on FAT32 — use a drive formatted as exFAT or NTFS
state.changed: Changed (the file is there, but its bytes are not what was copied)
state.unreadable: Unreadable (the drive cannot return the bytes — a sign of a failing drive)
err.dest_count: Choose one or two backup destinations.
err.overlap: The source and the backups must be different folders, and none may be inside another.
err.reserved: The top of the source folder contains VaultDrop service files: {names}
err.empty: There are no files in {path} — nothing to back up.
err.space: Not enough space on {path}: {need} needed, {free} free.
err.no_ledger: {path} is not a VaultDrop backup: {file} is missing.
err.ledger_read: Cannot read the backup index in {path}: {error}
err.ledger_damaged: The backup index in {path} is damaged (checksum mismatch). If the backup was complete, copy .vaultdrop.json and .vaultdrop.json.xxh64 from your second backup.
err.ledger_format: The backup index in {path} has an unknown format: {error}
err.gone: The drive with {path} disappeared during the check.
rep.files: Files: {total}; written to every backup and verified from disk: {ok}
rep.safe: Every file was written to every backup, read back from the drive itself (bypassing the Windows cache), and its xxHash64 checksum matched the original.
rep.one_copy: There is only one backup. Two backups on different drives are safer.
rep.fail: DO NOT delete or format the originals: not every file reached every backup.
rep.no_ledger: No backup index was written to {dest} — this backup cannot be checked later.
rep.more: …and {n} more; the full list is in {file}
rep.interrupted: The previous backup was interrupted in: {list}. Its temporary files were removed and everything was copied again.
rep.links: Links (symlinks, junctions) are not copied: {n}. They do not affect the result.
rep.system: System files at the drive root were skipped: {list}.
rep.eject: Before unplugging the drive, use “Safely Remove Hardware”.
rep.verify_hint: To check this backup later: VaultDrop → “Check a backup”, or run: vaultdrop verify --target {path}
ver.title: VaultDrop {version} — check of {path}
ver.counts: Files checked: {total}; intact: {intact}; changed: {changed}; missing: {missing}; unreadable: {unreadable}
ver.how: Checked {date}: every file was read back from the drive, bypassing the Windows cache.
ver.unfinished: WARNING: the last backup into this folder did not finish — files may not match the index. Run the backup again.
ver.incomplete: WARNING: this backup was incomplete from the start — see vaultdrop-incident.txt in this folder.
ver.more: …and {n} more; the full list is in the --json output
cli.copy: copy a folder to 1-2 backups and verify every file from disk
cli.source: folder to back up, e.g. D:\Projects
cli.dest: one or two backup folders separated by a comma: E:\bak,F:\bak
cli.to: backup folder, used as is (may contain commas); repeat for a second backup
cli.verify: read a backup back from disk and compare it with its index
cli.json: JSON Lines events on stdout (for the app)
ui.tagline: A verified copy of your files on a USB stick or an external drive. Works offline.
ui.step.dest_hint: Select up to two drives, or choose a folder below.
ui.drives_none: No drives found. Plug in a USB stick or an external drive.
ui.max_two: You can choose up to two places.
ui.never_changes: VaultDrop never changes or deletes your original files.
ui.need_dest: Choose at least one drive or folder for the backup.
ui.warn.title: Please confirm
ui.warn.same_disk: {path} is on the same physical drive as the source. If that drive fails, you lose both the originals and the backup. Continue anyway?
ui.warn.system: {path} is on this computer's system drive. It will not protect you if the computer fails or is lost. Continue anyway?
ui.warn.not_empty: The folder {path} already contains files that are not a VaultDrop backup. Files with the same names will be overwritten. Continue?
ui.warn.space: Not enough space on {path}: {need} needed, {free} free.
ui.result.safe.title: Backup complete and verified
ui.result.safe.text: Every included file reached every backup and passed verification. Keep another independent copy of important files and safely eject the drive.
ui.result.fail.title: Backup incomplete
ui.result.fail.text: Some files did not reach every backup. Do not delete or format the originals. The problems are listed below.
ui.result.intact.title: All files are intact
ui.result.intact.text: Every file in the backup was read from the drive and matches what was copied.
ui.result.damaged.title: Problems found
ui.result.damaged.text: Some files have changed, disappeared or cannot be read. If you still have the originals, make a new backup.
ui.result.error.title: Operation could not complete
ui.found_none: No backups found on connected drives. Plug in the backup drive or choose the folder manually.
ui.stop_text: A backup or check is running. Stop it and close VaultDrop? You can run it again later — nothing will be lost.
ui.local_note: No cloud. No account. Just your files and your drives.
ui.copy_intro: Copy a folder to your drive. We’ll read every file back to make sure it arrived intact.
ui.source_hint: A folder, with everything inside it.
ui.scan_partial: Some folders could not be read
ui.auto_verify_hint: Every copied file is read back from the drive and compared with the original.
ui.two_copies_note: For extra peace of mind, keep two copies on separate physical drives.
ui.verify_intro: Check an existing backup for changed, missing or unreadable files. Your backup stays untouched.
ui.awake: Your computer will stay awake until this finishes.
ui.stop_run_text: Stop this operation? Originals stay untouched. An unfinished backup must be run again.
ui.result.cancelled.title: Operation stopped
ui.result.cancelled.text: Your originals are unchanged. Run the backup or check again when you’re ready.
ui.result.incomplete.title: This backup is incomplete
ui.result.incomplete.text: The indexed files match, but the backup did not finish successfully. Keep the originals and run the backup again.
ui.process_failed: The operation ended without a final result (code {code}). See technical details.
ui.footer: Offline by design. Verified by reading.
ui.preview: Design preview — sample data, no files will be copied.
err.backup_busy: Another backup is already writing to {path}. Wait for it to finish.
ui.warn.other_source: {path} contains a backup of a different source folder. Files with matching names and the old backup index will be replaced. Continue?
